Context: 3. Retirement on Medical Grounds

## 3. Retirement on Medical Grounds  
[ Swamy's Pension Compilation]  
A Central Government employee who suffers on account of any bodily or mental infirmity which permanently incapacitates him for the service may retire from service with pensionary benefits. He will be granted Invalid Pension, Retirement Gratuity, encashment of leave and family  
pension to the members of his family in the event of his death.
